title: a-sole-path-admission-without-an-exemption-entry-reds
intention: A sole-path rule that admits a single file beyond its own device directory reds the inspector unless the exemption set carries an entry for that admission at that seat.
why: Today an admission can widen a sole-path door with nothing red. Measured 2026-10-05 on a clone of cairn 6b3e185b with the three inference-sole-path-admits-bus-client entries removed and test_exemption_set.py at its pre-build bytes (27d6e15e): build_inspector over exemptions, inference_domain, build_inspector, bus_client and corrosion added no finding, and test_exemption_set ran 48/0. The registry is a convention kept by hand; the hollow of f5a344e6c629 read exemption_set.json hollow (n-0b38a3cb9da2) for exactly this reason. 892a0f9cd925 checks set->code (an entry resolves and its symbol is at its path) and names code->set as its residue: 'never listing a site in the first place does not'.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy); RULE 1's sole-path door (import_sieve); ticket 892a0f9cd925's recorded residue; notice n-0b38a3cb9da2.
how: In cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py add sole_path_admissions_are_entered(row, comp_dir) beside every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility and register it in the same sieve list (inspector.py ~3554). Gate: return [] unless row['component'] == 'exemptions'. Find the repo root by walking up from comp_dir to the dir holding .git (as the neighbouring sieve does). Walk every .py under it, skipping any path with a 'fixtures' or '.git' segment; ast.parse each (skip SyntaxError); for each ast.Dict whose constant keys include both 'modules' and 'only', ast.literal_eval the 'only' value (skip unless str or tuple of str). Each member not ending in '/' is a file admission. Load comp_dir/'exemption_set.json' key 'exemptions'; an admission is entered when some entry has path == the seat's repo-relative posix path and the member text is a substring of its symbol. Each unentered admission -> _finding('sole_path_admissions_are_entered', row['component'], 'admission entered: <seat>::<member>', expected=True, actual=False, seat=<seat>, member=<member>, lack='add an exemption_set entry with path <seat> and a symbol containing <member>'). New proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_an_unentered_admission_reds.py, red-first, seeding tmp roots (with a .git dir, a seat .py, and cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json) and calling the sieve directly with row={'component':'exemptions'} and comp_dir=<root>/cairn/machines/exemptions; tooth 5 calls inspect(component='exemptions') on the live repo.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) on a seeded root holding one rule literal whose 'only' is ('x_domain/', 'tools/y/z.py') and an exemption set with no entry for it, the sieve returns exactly one finding naming the seat path and 'tools/y/z.py'; (2) adding an entry with that path and a symbol containing 'tools/y/z.py' returns []; (3) a rule whose 'only' holds only directory members ('x_domain/') returns [] with no entry; (4) a rule literal under a fixtures/ directory returns []; (5) inspect(component='exemptions') over the live repo carries no finding of method sole_path_admissions_are_entered. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if it reds a door directory, or matches on entry count instead of seat+member. Horizon: PROVED, then a sole-path admission widened without an entry reds the exemptions component at its next inspection.
watchme: none, because the sieve runs inside build_inspector at every inspection of the exemptions component and its finding IS the report; the exemptions machine's own probe cairn/machines/exemptions/probes/every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility.py already reports the set on its watch
children: none, because the change is one sieve function, its registration, and one proof in build_inspector
questions: none, because the scope choice (rule literals only, not every exemption construct) is settled by the docstring at cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py ('nothing here discovers an exemption site nobody entered') and build-minimal; general discovery stays 892a0f9cd925's recorded residue

decisions.text: D2: SETTLED: Register it in the SIEVES dict of cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py by adding the line '    "sole_path_admissions_are_entered": sole_path_admissions_are_entered,' directly after the two-line entry '"every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility":\n        every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility,'. No other table needs the name: SIEVES is the only registry inspect() reads.

D3: SETTLED: Create cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_an_unentered_admission_reds.py with exactly this content; its PROVES maps clauses 1-5 of the falsifier to the five teeth in order:
"""A sole-path file admission with no exemption entry at its seat reds (ticket b364df579e49).

sole_path_admissions_are_entered reads every import_sieve rule literal (a dict carrying
'modules' and 'only') and needs an exemption_set entry, matched on seat path + member text,
for each member that admits a single file past the door. Four teeth seed tmp roots and call
the sieve directly; the fifth runs inspect(component='exemptions') over the live repo. The
inspector is imported inside each tooth, so a reverted inspector.py reds a tooth instead of
breaking the file.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))

from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch import scratch_dir  # noqa: E402

PROVES = {"b364df579e49": {
    "1": "test_an_unentered_file_admission_reds_once",
    "2": "test_an_entry_at_the_seat_clears_it",
    "3": "test_a_directory_member_needs_no_entry",
    "4": "test_a_rule_under_fixtures_is_skipped",
    "5": "test_the_live_repo_reads_clean",
}}

_SEAT = "tools/x/rules.py"


def _seed(only: str, entries: list[dict], seat: str = _SEAT) -> Path:
    root = scratch_dir("cairn-unentered-admission-")
    (root / ".git").mkdir()
    (root / seat).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / seat).write_text('RULE = {"modules": ("socket",), "only": %s}\n' % only)
    comp = root / "cairn" / "machines" / "exemptions"
    comp.mkdir(parents=True)
    (comp / "exemption_set.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exemptions": entries}))
    return comp


def _run(comp: Path) -> list[dict]:
    from cairn.machines.build_inspector import inspector
    return inspector.sole_path_admissions_are_entered({"component": "exemptions"}, comp)


def test_an_unentered_file_admission_reds_once():
    found = _run(_seed("('x_domain/', 'tools/y/z.py')", []))
    abouts = [f.get("about", "") for f in found]
    assert len(found) == 1 and _SEAT in abouts[0] and "tools/y/z.py" in abouts[0], abouts


def test_an_entry_at_the_seat_clears_it():
    found = _run(_seed("('x_domain/', 'tools/y/z.py')",
                       [{"id": "x-admits-z", "path": _SEAT, "symbol": '"tools/y/z.py"'}]))
    assert found == [], [f.get("about") for f in found]


def test_a_directory_member_needs_no_entry():
    found = _run(_seed("('x_domain/',)", []))
    assert found == [], [f.get("about") for f in found]


def test_a_rule_under_fixtures_is_skipped():
    found = _run(_seed("('x_domain/', 'tools/y/z.py')", [], seat="tools/fixtures/rules.py"))
    assert found == [], [f.get("about") for f in found]


def test_the_live_repo_reads_clean():
    from cairn.machines.build_inspector import inspector
    assert "sole_path_admissions_are_entered" in inspector.SIEVES
    report = inspector.inspect(component="exemptions")
    mine = [f for f in report["findings"] if f.get("method") == "sole_path_admissions_are_entered"]
    assert mine == [], [f.get("about") for f in mine]


def main() -> int:
    fails = 0
    for name in PROVES["b364df579e49"].values():
        try:
            globals()[name]()
            print(f"  ok   {name}")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — every tooth reports, none hides
            fails += 1
            print(f"  FAIL {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    print("RED" if fails else "GREEN")
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

Write the proof (D3) first and seal it red with 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_an_unentered_admission_reds.py' before any inspector.py edit; all five teeth red then because inspector has no attribute sole_path_admissions_are_entered. Commit. Then apply D1 and D2, run the proof (expect GREEN, 5 ok), and commit; the pre-commit reseal door reseals it green.

D5: SETTLED: Nothing else changes. exemption_set.json gains no entry (the three live file admissions, cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (bus_client/remote.py), cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_host.py and cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_import_sieve.py, are all entered already, census 2026-10-05: 769 files, 10 rule literals, 3 file members). sieve.py, test_exemption_set.py and corrosion's constraint_set.json are untouched.

D6: SETTLED: The mechanics D4 names. 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 <proof>' runs the proof file as a subprocess and writes its verdict to the matching validations/<proof-stem>.json beside the proofs/ folder; the proof prints one line per tooth, 'ok' or 'FAIL', then RED (any tooth failed, exit 1) or GREEN (all passed, exit 0). Before D1+D2 the expected print is five FAIL lines (AttributeError: module has no attribute 'sole_path_admissions_are_entered') then RED, and the seal records verdict red. Commit with 'git add <proof> <validation json> && git commit -m "b364df579e49: proof sealed red"' from ~/dev/src/cairn. After D1+D2 run 'python3 <proof>' and expect five ok lines then GREEN; then 'git add cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py && git commit -m "b364df579e49: build"'. The pre-commit hook (the reseal door) sees that the proof's source fingerprint moved and re-runs the seal itself, staging the green validation into the same commit; no hand action is needed for it. If that hook times out, run the seal by hand with --timeout 900 and commit the validation.
